mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the constraint that defines allowed (role, op) pairs. The LeastPrivilege assertion checks that allowed pairs respect the closed-world list; without the fact, Alloy can construct instances with arbitrary role-operation pairs.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ExtraPermission { Member -> OpDelete in PermMatrix.allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: This fact enforces that audit entries are logically persistent (no DELETE/UPDATE paths). Removing it allows the model to construct deleted or mutated audit entries; the AppendOnly predicate should fail.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditDeletion { some ae: AuditEntry | ae not in AuditEntry }

mutation_targets.rationale: This fact enforces that every audit entry's actor_role matches the actor's real role. Removing it allows mismatched roles; AttributionCorrectness should find a counterexample.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_RoleMismatch { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.actor_role != ae.actor.role }

mutation_targets.rationale: This fact strictly isolates cross-team users from tasks in other teams. Removing it allows a user in team A to be a sharee on a task in team B; FR_006 should fail.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamShare { some u: User, t: Task, ts: TaskShare | ts.task = t and ts.sharee = u and u.team != t.team }

mutation_targets.rationale: This fact prevents the task owner from being listed as a sharee (redundant). Removing it allows self-shares; FR_010 should detect the violation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SelfShare { some ts: TaskShare | ts.sharee = ts.task.owner }

mutation_targets.rationale: This fact ties all access to team membership and either ownership, sharing, or admin status. Removing it allows arbitrary cross-team access or access by unrelated users; both assertions should find violations.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnrelatedAccess { some u: User, t: Task | u.team = t.team and u != t.owner and u.role = Member and not (some ts: TaskShare | ts.task = t and ts.sharee = u) }
